issues.description: The problem statement (UML) specifies Pneumatic.openValve() as a no-argument method (openValve(): void), but the solution repository declares Pneumatic.openValve(int duration) with an int parameter. This is a cross-artifact method-parameter mismatch: students reading the problem will implement openValve() with no parameters, but the solution/reference uses a different signature. This prevents a consistent understanding of the required interface and will confuse students about the correct method signature to implement.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Pneumatic.openValve method signature consistent with the UML/problem statement. Either (A) change the solution's Pneumatic interface to declare void openValve() (no parameters) and keep implementations without parameters, or (B) update the problem statement/UML to indicate openValve(int duration) and update text/instructions accordingly. Option (A) is recommended to match the UML as given.
